name: rhein-ruhr-fahrplan-mcp
description: ÖPNV-Fahrplandaten für das Rhein-Ruhr-Gebiet (Deutschland): Live-Abfahrten und Ankünfte mit Echtzeitprognosen und Verspätungen, Verbindungsplanung, Störungshinweise sowie optionaler GTFS-Sollplan (monatlich automatisch aktualisiert, gefiltert auf konfigurierbare Verkehrsunternehmen). Datenbasis: VRR-OpenData (EFA + GTFS), keine API-Keys erforderlich.

FAHRPLAN_AGENCY_IDS.description: Optional: Comma-separated GTFS agency IDs to enable the schedule database (e.g. 'nia-25' for buses in the Kleve/Wesel districts). Without it, the server runs live-only (departures/connections/disruptions) and schedule tools return a configuration hint. Unfiltered import would create a ~500 MB database and is intentionally not the default.

FAHRPLAN_OPERATOR.description: Optional: filter live departures/arrivals by operator code (e.g. 'NIAG'). Empty = all operators.

FAHRPLAN_DEFAULT_START.description: Optional: default start stop (DHID like 'de:05154:35739', EFA ID or unique name). Available via the get_default_start tool.

tools.name: find_stop
tools.description: Find a stop in the Rhein-Ruhr area (GTFS index with live EFA fallback). Returns stop ID, name, DHID (global ID) and coordinates.

tools.name: get_default_start
tools.description: Resolve the configured default start stop (FAHRPLAN_DEFAULT_START) to its canonical DHID and name.

tools.name: next_departures
tools.description: Live departures with real-time predictions: line, direction, scheduled and estimated time, delay in minutes, platform and disruption notices.

tools.name: stop_schedule
tools.description: Planned schedule from the GTFS feed (next departures, supports day_offset for tomorrow etc.).

tools.name: plan_connection
tools.description: Plan a connection from A to B across the whole network (optional departure_time 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM').

tools.name: line_disruptions
tools.description: Current disruptions/construction works/stop relocations for a stop (optionally filtered by line).

tools.name: sync_status
tools.description: GTFS feed status: version, validity range, row counts.

tools.name: update_feed
tools.description: Check CKAN for a newer GTFS feed; only imports when a new resource exists (idempotent).

uvx.description: Run via uvx from PyPI (stdio). Live-only by default; set FAHRPLAN_AGENCY_IDS for the schedule database.

pip.description: Install via pip and run the entry point (stdio). Live-only by default; set FAHRPLAN_AGENCY_IDS for schedules.

examples.title: Next departures
examples.prompt: When does the next bus leave from Moers Bahnhof?

examples.title: Connection planning
examples.description: Plan a trip with a specific departure time
examples.prompt: Plan a connection from Kleve Bahnhof to Duisburg Hbf departing at 3pm.

examples.title: Disruptions
examples.prompt: Are there any disruptions or construction works affecting buses at Kleve Bahnhof?
